# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Mask filtered glyph hardening**

## Highlights

Upcoming Skia m157 servicing hardens mask-filtered glyph rendering against inconsistent font-scaler output.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Reloaded glyph paths and masks stay consistent** — Uses the reloaded glyph's own outline or raster image instead of stale path state. Incompatible or non-overlapping masks produce cleared output rather than invalid copies, and clipped embossed glyphs use full plane strides. This prevents sub-byte overwrites and corrupted mask planes without changing managed APIs. ([#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
